But the function only returns results; we can filter ourselves. But the function may return many results; we can then pick top 4. We can call with rating 4.0 to get high rated ones.

3. Find cheapest round-trip flight from New York to Los Angeles. So call flight_search with _from "New York", to "Los Angeles", type "round-trip".

We need to call the functions accordingly. We'll do three calls: restaurant_search for Chinese in New York, restaurant_search for Italian in Los Angeles with rating 4.0, flight_search for round-trip.
